title: Narrow third amendment: default-scenario backend identity capture and bounded timeout input
frozen_before: any reevaluation under the narrowly-corrected tools

supersedes.note: Additive and narrow. Original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256, amendment 1/2, both correction contracts and all prior receipts are preserved byte-for-byte.

reason: Final narrow review blocked 852ddb6 for one outcome-recording bug (default_clean_long backend_kind assigned only when a join occurred) and one input-validation gap (--timeout-s). All N1-N8 are otherwise accepted.

default_backend_identity.defect: runDefaultCleanLong assigned backend_kind only inside `!joinObserved && drumsPlaying`, so a legitimate 16 s no-lock default run wrote an empty backend_kind and failed identity falsely.
default_backend_identity.correction: Capture the actual default backend from the FIRST COHERENT PREPARED state after prepareToPlay (and each successful read), independent of join. Label experimentalBTrack only when the field actually is experimentalBTrack; preserve an unavailable/unknown/failure backend as recorded, never blind-copy the bootstrap signal. Track first-observed vs last-observed; a change of the actual backend tag within one prepared session is a fail-closed identity discrepancy, and the wrong identity is never overwritten by an eventual experimental value.
default_backend_identity.outcome_separation: joinObserved, steps_fired and audio metrics remain separate measured outcomes. A default run that does not acquire a lock in 16 s is a legitimate DIAGNOSTIC quality outcome recorded exactly, not an identity failure and not tuned after the run. The first-slice join proof is the injected scenario; no >=95% claim is made.

timeout_input.defect: run_replay --timeout-s accepted any float, including 0, negative, NaN, inf or >300.
timeout_input.correction: Reject non-finite, <=0 or >300 before invoking any subprocess, returning exit 64 consistent with the preregistered cap; the default 300 is unchanged. A user override can never exceed the frozen bound.

gates.note: structural AND rt_gate AND join_gate; default_clean_long no-lock is diagnostic, not a gate failure.

immutable_preserved.note: New pins/receipt are recorded in new files; no historical hash is rewritten.
